Who I Work With

Not everyone.
The right people.

Nikki doesn't work with everyone — and that's intentional. The clients she takes on, she's fully committed to. Here's who she works best with.

Athletes & Active People

For people who use their body hard
and need it to work.

Trail runners. Cyclists. Gym athletes. Yoga practitioners. People who train hard and feel every accumulation of that training in their body.

The work I do for active people isn't about recovery in the spa sense. It's about understanding what your training is doing to your tissue — the fascial restrictions building up from repetitive motion, the structural imbalances your body has been compensating around, the tightness that's affecting your stride, your range of motion, your output.

I've been trail running in Traverse City for years. I know this body type. I know what it carries.

"It felt like years of pushups, chatarangas, burpees and mountain-climbers melted away."

Barbara Sennrich

"She worked my whole body, which most therapists don't. She was very intuitive the whole time. She is worth every dollar and a good tip."

Sasha King, LMT & Competitive Athlete

Chronic Pain & Recovery

For people who have tried everything else
and are tired of managing it.

You know the pattern. Something hurts. You stretch it, ice it, see the chiropractor. It gets better for a while. Then you're back.

The reason it keeps coming back is usually that the root cause hasn't been addressed — the fascial restriction, the structural imbalance, the compensatory pattern your body developed years ago that nobody has found yet.

That's the conversation I want to have.

"I have battled lower back and upper back issues for quite a few years. I've done the whole chiropractor thing and it works for a little while but have to go back quite regularly. I told my chiropractor about Nikki and she said 'I have to meet this Nikki — she has fixed 3 of my patients over the last year.' Nikki has made it so that those symptoms are gone 95 percent of the time for me."

Adam

"I had been experiencing a lot of aches and pains, stress in the neck and shoulders as well as tension headaches and migraines... It has made a huge difference in my every day activity when seeing her on a regular basis."

Michelle Mitchell
